verdict.rationale: SavvyCal publishes a structured API reference for its REST API. It lists endpoints such as GET /v1/events, POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events and GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots, along with auth schemes (OAuth2, Bearer, personal access tokens). It also invites users to 'try it out' with a personal access token. Nothing explicitly shows an interactive in-browser console or runnable code examples. missing for 10: documented interactive 'try it' request console, runnable/copyable code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
